Subject: Weekly Sync: Ferraro account

Where: City Hall, Room 210 (and Teams)
To: Ines Vasquez, Ximena Mbatha, Wes Ilunga, Zoe Grummond, Farid Mbatha, Liam Brennan, Finance liaison, Procurement desk

Hello everyone,

Setting up a recurring weekly time for us to touch base on the Ferraro account and make sure we're all on the same page. There's been a lot moving lately and I'd like to make sure nothing slips through the cracks, especially with the budget cycle coming up and the City of Orbitlight review process being what it is.

The plan is just to go around and hear where each area stands, flag anything concerning, and keep a general pulse on things. Nothing formal. If we end early, great.

If you can't make it, please send someone or at least send me a quick note on your status so I can pass it along. I'd really appreciate it.

Thanks so much,
Leon"}]}
